description: This file defines the class `TransformationXForms` which is a snippet demonstrating various transformations (such as rotation, scaling, skewing) applied to images within a PDF document using the PDFsharp library. It contains rendering logic that draws rectangles and images with different transformation matrices.

classes.name: TransformationXForms
classes.description: A class for demonstrating transformations of XForms in a PDF using PDFsharp.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Overrides the method to render a series of transformation demonstrations on the provided graphics context.
